entities.name: Kavu
entities.description: Carnivorous mutant reptiles native to Dominaria, revived by Multani's magic during the Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Kav
entities.description: Sapient Kavu-folk of the Edge, native to Kavaron.

entities.name: Multani
entities.description: Entity whose magic revived the Kavu.

entities.name: Hallar
entities.description: Elven knight with a strong bond to the Kavu steed Serahane.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: War in which the Kavu fought.

events.summary: During the Phyrexian Invasion Multani's magic revives the Kavu, who go about fighting the war.
events.quote: During the Phyrexian Invasion , Multani 's magic revived them, and they immediately went about fighting the war.

relations.quote: Hallar in particular is considered to have a particularly strong bond with their Kavu steed, Serahane .
They are native to the planet Kavaron
